youtube.aciklama: The middle latency response (MLR) is clearly affected by sleep, sedation and age: in deep, slow-wave sleep Pa may shrink or disappear, sedative drugs and general anesthesia suppress the response, and in young children Pa cannot always be recorded. So sleep, drugs and muscle artifact are checked first; only when the response is absent under good conditions does the finding gain clinical meaning.
